Later live native/evidence changes do not alter that pair comparison; switching either side is explicit. Incompatible subject/project/model/schema/scope and unavailable historical information produce explained comparability/uncertainty or refusal rather than inferred equivalence.

AC-3: Native comparison explains added/removed membership, type/key/resource/field differences and version-only changes with exact original/current-selected versions, schemas and provenance. Missing versus null, ordered arrays and nested JSON remain meaningful. Removed-from-configuration is distinct from deleted-from-project, and mutable current liveness is not silently substituted for the selected state.

AC-4: Selected relationship topology comparison preserves exact endpoints, type, metadata and contextual-reference role/selector/state changes, including relinking, removed relationships and historical endpoints. AC-5: Content comparison uses explicitly captured resource/observation identities, availability and hashes/commits; annotation changes and observed-byte changes remain separate. Same hash is not identity merging or byte retention, and document change cannot establish passage change without sufficient selected evidence. Reads perform no observer IO and never replace pinned selections with the latest observation.

AC-6: Configuration-bound dependency/applicability analysis explains changed inputs, potentially affected and unaffected declared scope, exact inclusion/exclusion basis and remaining uncertainty. Captured input field/path/direct-link/content semantics are reused; incomplete scope, absent evidence and unknown availability cannot establish no impact. Bounded populations and summaries state completeness and refuse overflow explicitly.

AC-7: Controlled pair-bound assessments preserve the original pair/policy and every discovered obligation, reasoned disposition, action and immutable conclusion. No-action, investigation, required revision and re-verification remain distinct. Pair/policy changes require explicit reassessment while retaining prior judgments; closure requires complete accounting under the pinned policy and never implies release approval.

Existing current-head verification keeps its meaning. Failed/not_run results stay non-passing; generic reviews/status strings cannot override changed governing criteria, incomplete accounting or unknown support. Work executed after configuration capture can support that candidate only through validated exact input correspondence and explicit provenance, never by silently adding membership.

Atomic guards reject stale/concurrent/invalid proposals without partial state/history/evidence/outcomes; failed reads pause writes and uncertain writes are inspected without automatic replay. A fresh independent agent completes an unfamiliar task and material findings are addressed; human validation remains separate.
